items.title: India’s richest man now wants to turn aging computers into AI-ready PCs
items.feed_excerpt: Jio is betting it can turn an aging computer into an AI-ready PC for as little as about $11 for two months.

items.title: HiddenLayer nabs $100M as enterprises rush to secure their AI deployments
items.feed_excerpt: HiddenLayer has raised a $100M Series B from Delta-v Capital, Ten Eleven Ventures, Morgan Stanley, Microsoft's M12, Booz Allen Hamilton, and others.

items.title: PSA: Amazon’s shopping AI can now tell you if that message is a scam
items.feed_excerpt: Amazon is adding a scam-detection feature to Alexa for Shopping that can verify whether suspicious emails, texts, and other messages actually came from the retailer.

items.title: Adobe acquires Indian market intelligence startup Rilo
items.feed_excerpt: This is Adobe's second acquisition out of India after Rephrase.ai in 2023

items.title: Norway considers ban on camera-enabled wearable ‘pervert glasses’
items.feed_excerpt: The Nordic country says wearable camera headsets need to be regulated given their privacy risks.

items.title: Adobe is making its tools available in Slack
items.feed_excerpt: Users will be able to access Express, Premiere, and Acrobat in Slack

items.title: Uber is laying off 10% of staff, or 3,300 people
items.feed_excerpt: Uber is laying off about 3,300 people, or about 10% of its global headcount, in a bid to reduce management layers and invest more in its ridesharing, delivery, and robotaxi divisions.

items.title: OpenAI faces 30 more lawsuits tied to Tumbler Ridge shooting
items.feed_excerpt: Edelson PC is filing 30 new lawsuits against OpenAI over the Tumbler Ridge shooting, escalating claims to aiding and abetting and naming Chris Lehane, though evidence remains unconfirmed.
